name: Nashtifan vertical-axis wind milling
description: Eastern Iranian asbads use wind to drive grain millstones.

places.note: Modern country or regional reference; historic political boundaries are not implied.

events.statement: A heritage nomination documented an operating windmill at Nashtifan and wind-powered grain milling in eastern Iran.
events.caveats: 2017 is the submission date, not the mill’s construction or invention date; the nomination’s centuries-old characterization is not a precise dating.

evidence.supports: The nomination describes the operating mill and regional millstones.
